name: Isometric Blocks
description: Tumbling isometric cubes in a mixed ink palette, sized as a seamless repeating tile.

code.style: --rule: ( background-size: 83px 135px; background-color: var(--color1); background-image: @doodle( @grid: 2 / 100%; background: @pn(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color3)); transform-origin: @pn(100% 100%, 0 100%, 100% 0, 0 0); transform: rotateX(45deg) skewY(@pn(34deg, -34deg, -34deg)); ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
